description: This file defines the ScreenWebView SwiftUI component that manages a WebView, including its lifecycle, coordination, and navigation handling within a SwiftUI app. It incorporates a coordinator class for WebView setup, updates, and teardown, along with delegate classes for navigation policies and message handling.

classes.name: ScreenWebView
classes.description: A SwiftUI representable for embedding a WKWebView, managing creation and updates of the web view via a coordinator.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Handles setup, update, and teardown of the WKWebView instance, manages navigation delegate and message handlers, and maintains references to the web view and its container.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: A WKNavigationDelegate subclass that intercepts URL navigation actions, particularly deep links with openclaw:// scheme, and communicates with the controller.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A WKScriptMessageHandler that processes messages from web content to trigger actions in the controller.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures a container UIView with an embedded WKWebView, set up with constraints and delegate assignments.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and reattaches/detaches the web view as needed when the controller changes.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up by removing message handlers, detaching the web view, and nullifying references.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Creates and configures a WKWebView with non-persistent data store and specific visual and scroll settings.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Adds message handlers for specified message names to the userContentController.

methods.name: removeA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Removes message handlers from the userContentController.
